base_pinning_fix.old_behavior: S2 worktree creation used moving origin/main directly.
base_pinning_fix.new_behavior: S1 captures BASE_SHA with git rev-parse origin/main into /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt; S2 verifies origin/main still equals BASE_SHA, creates the worktree from BASE_SHA, then tests git rev-parse HEAD equals BASE_SHA.
stop_conditions_added: Stop if origin/main changes after capture and before worktree creation unless the operator explicitly accepts the newer base.
Stop if worktree HEAD does not equal the captured base SHA.

dirty_state_gate_fix.old_behavior: S1 declared a stop condition for dirty tracked state but the command list only observed repository status.
dirty_state_gate_fix.new_behavior: S1 writes tracked status to /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_TRACKED_STATUS_BEFORE.txt, exits 1 if non-empty, and runs git diff --quiet plus git diff --cached --quiet. S2 writes the fresh worktree tracked status to /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_WORKTREE_TRACKED_STATUS.txt and exits 1 if non-empty.
dirty_state_gate_fix.untracked_artifacts: Ignored intentionally via --untracked-files=no; this gate is only for tracked dirty state.

ancestor_gate_fix.old_behavior: S1 captured PR #709/#710 metadata but did not fail closed on prerequisite ancestry against the verification base.
ancestor_gate_fix.new_behavior: S1 now tests PR #709 and PR #710 state == MERGED, fetches headRefOid and mergeCommit.oid via gh, requires each value to be non-empty, and runs git merge-base --is-ancestor for each SHA against BASE_SHA from /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt.
ancestor_gate_fix.moving_origin_main_after_capture: Avoided for ancestry and prerequisite artifact reads; commands use BASE_SHA read from /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt.
